article.p: Font optimization utilities for loading, preloading, and optimizing font display.
Creates a FontFace object for a custom font:

pre.class: language-javascript p-4 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto text-sm mb-6
pre.code:
import { defineFontFace } from 'metaowl'
const fontFace = defineFontFace({ family: 'MyFont', src: '/fonts/MyFont.woff2', weight: 'normal', style: 'normal', display: 'swap', unicodeRange: 'U+0-FFFF' })

article.p: Asynchronously loads fonts and adds them to the document font cache:

pre.class: language-javascript p-4 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto text-sm mb-6

article.p: Checks if a font or specific weight has been loaded:

pre.class: language-javascript p-4 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto text-sm mb-6
pre.code:
import { isFontLoaded, loadFont } from 'metaowl'
await loadFont({ family: 'MyFont', src: '/fonts/MyFont.woff2', weight: 'normal' })
isFontLoaded('MyFont') // true isFontLoaded('MyFont', 'bold') // false

article.p: Composite API that provides all font utilities under one namespace:

pre.class: language-javascript p-4 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto text-sm mb-6
pre.code:
import { Fonts } from 'metaowl'
Fonts.defineFontFace() Fonts.loadFont() Fonts.loadFontFamily() Fonts.isFontLoaded() Fonts.preloadFont() Fonts.removeFontPreload() Fonts.injectFontFaceRules() Fonts.measureTextWidth() Fonts.adjustFontForFout() Fonts.getFontLoadStatus() Fonts.clearLoadedFonts()
